title: Two-Way Google Sheets and Monday.com Deal Sync
summary: Deal and transaction data stays in sync between Google Sheets and Monday.com, triggered from a custom Sheets menu.
headline: Sheets and Monday.com, always in sync
problem: The same deal data was kept in two places and updated by hand.
solution: Using Apps Script and the Monday.com GraphQL API, I built a bidirectional sync with batch processing and API retries, plus custom menus in Sheets so users run updates themselves.
highlights: Financial, escrow, deposit, notes and status fields
role: Sole engineer. I built the whole integration.

results.label: More accurate deal data across both tools
